{{samename|character from {{Pokémon XD}} whose Japanese name is Mana|Jovi}} {{CharInfobox |color={{moon color}} |corecolor={{moon color light}} |bordercolor={{moon color dark}} |name=Mana |jname=マナ |tmname=Mana |image=Mana.png |size=200px |caption=Mana |age=yes |years=8 |gender=Female |hometown=Unknown |region=[[Alola]] (originally [[Kanto]]) |colors=yes |eyes=Light brown |hair=Light brown |trainer=yes |trainerclass={{pkmn|Trainer}} |game=counterpart |counterpart={{ga|Selene}} }} '''Mana''' (Japanese: '''マナ''' ''Mana'') is a main character who appeared in [[Pokémon Horizon]]. ==Pokémon== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Mana |pkmn=Decidueye |width=72 |stage1=Rowlet |stage2=Dartrix |nick= |gender=male |type1=Grass |type2=Ghost |img=Mana Rowlet.png |img2=Mana Decidueye.png |epnum=HOR01 |epname=Journey to a New Horizon |desc={{p|Rowlet}} is Mana's first known Pokémon. Rowlet appears for the first time battling a wild {{p|Drampa}} in ''[[HOR01|Journey to a New Horizon]]'' that was out of control near [[Professor Kukui]]'s Laboratory, despite all his efforts, he is no match for the dragon type pokemon, being saved by Rockruff in the process. Mana tries to use him again to battle a huge wild Pangoro in ''[[HOR03|Traveling Trainer Tokio]]'', but is interrupted by Tokio. Mana uses Rowlet again to show {{hor|Akira}} how a [[Z-Ring]] works in ''[[HOR04|Mastering the Z-Move]]''. In ''[[HOR08|The Legend Revealed]]'', it is revealed that Rowlet evolved during Akira and Mana's journey in [[Alola]] sometime before ''[[HOR07|Attack on the Headquarters]]''. Mana uses {{p|Decidueye}} to face a {{p|Crobat}} from a [[Team Kings]] Grunt, easily defeating the Pokémon Bat. During the final battle against [[Meja]], Mana uses Decidueye against Meja's own Decidueye, after a tough battle, Mana wins after using the Z-Move on the opposing Pokémon. Decidueye is last seen in ''[[HOR11|To a New Horizon]]'' alongside his {{pkmn|Trainer}}. Decidueye's known moves are {{m|Razor Leaf}} and {{m|Spirit Shackle}}{{tt|*|Never used, confirmed through the use of its exclusive Z-Move}}.
